items.title: Frank Foster and Bill Hughes interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Schenectady, New York, March 28, 1995
items.q: it’s just the feeling that they got, and I think it started with Basie himself.

ctx.x: No. People would come up to him, you know, lay people would come and say “Hello Count.”

items.title: Frank Foster and Bill Hughes interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Schenectady, New York, March 28, 1995
items.q: None of us ever called him Count.

ctx.x: Late 50’s, yeah, because early 50’s I’m pretty sure we weren’t calling him “Chief.”
None of us ever called him Count.
